message:
perf(x230): add qualified opt-in glibc arena execution profile

Reuse the qualified R14 source and binaries without recompilation. Default MALLOC_ARENA_MAX to 1 only through an explicit launcher, preserving caller controls and argv/PID behavior.

Verify 1637 tests with zero failures/retries, 33 ignored, and 1647 actual allocator-environment observations. Include independent performance and six-host recovery audits, full comparison tables, raw archives and actual blob receipts. Document substantial same-binary large-receipt RSS reductions alongside throughput and tail-latency costs; no universal speedup or optimality claim.
